q: The results of the experiment will be ______ in the next issue of the journal.
why: publish 发表；polish 打磨；punish 惩罚；purchase 购买。

q: Her outstanding performance won ______ from both teachers and classmates.
why: win admiration 赢得赞赏；admission 准许进入。

q: It is difficult to ______ the exact cause of the accident.
why: determine 确定；decline 下降/婉拒；decorate 装饰。

q: The government has taken measures to ______ the spread of the disease.
why: prevent the spread 阻止扩散；preserve 保存。

q: Children should be encouraged to think ______ instead of following others blindly.
The manager ______ the importance of teamwork again and again in his speech.
why: emphasize 强调；entertain 使娱乐；estimate 估计。

q: It is reported that the new medicine is quite ______ against this kind of disease.
why: be effective against… 对……有效；efficient 指“高效的”。

q: After months of consideration, she made a ______ decision to study abroad next year.
why: make a final decision 做最终决定。

q: The two countries agreed to ______ a new trade agreement.
why: sign an agreement 签署协议；sight 视力/景象（名词）。

q: We should ______ every opportunity to practise our spoken English.
why: seize the opportunity 抓住机会。
